svg.title: amp Album Detail with integrated play-all bar
svg.desc: Updated Album Detail view using the play-all bar pattern. The top chrome row contains a back button on the left and a wide green bar to its right that reads Kid A in mono bold black with a play triangle at the right edge — tapping the bar plays the entire album. Below is the stylized album artwork with cream background and dark red jagged mountain shapes evoking the Kid A cover. Beneath the art, the artist Radiohead and a metadata line 2000 middot 10 tracks middot 49:57 are centered. A yellow Tracks brutalist block follows, then a list of five tracks with track 8 Idioteque rendered as a navy inversion indicating it is currently playing. The bottom tab bar shows Library selected as a navy inversion, followed by Search, Queue, and Active.
